documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Un-Audited Financial Results For The Quarter Ended 30Th June, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: During FY 2024-25, Pasupati Acrylon Limited recorded Revenue from Operations of Rs. 62,143.18 Lakh, marking an 8.03% increase over the previous year. Profit after tax rose significantly by 168.24% to Rs. 3,538.12 Lakh. The company successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and commenced commercial production in March 2025.

guidance.claim: Management expects production and sales to improve further in coming years while monitoring external factors such as inflation and high energy prices.
guidance.quote: The sale and production has seen good improvement from previous year and it is expected to improve more in the coming years but it is necessary to carefully watch other factors such as inflation, high energy prices etc.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for acrylic fibers is expected to rise in coming years due to macroeconomic growth in end-use sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand for acrylic fibers is anticipated to rise in the coming years, particularly due to the macroeconomic development of end-use sectors which is supported by regional GDP and population growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The global market for CPP packaging films is projected to reach US$ 8,742.2 million by 2033 at a CAGR of 4.2%.
demand_outlook.quote: The global market for CPP packaging films is expected to reach US$ 8,742.2 Mn by 2033, growing at a 4.2% CAGR till 2033.

demand_outlook.claim: The overall acrylic fibre market is projected to grow at a CAGR of 4.2% until 2035.
demand_outlook.quote: With the rapid growth of the apparel & textile industry and increasing usage of acrylic fibres for making apparel, the overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at 4.2% CAGR till 2035.

demand_outlook.claim: The global ethanol market is expected to grow at a CAGR of 6.8% between 2023 and 2032.
demand_outlook.quote: The global ethanol market is anticipated to register a CAGR of 6.8% from 2023 to 2032.

demand_outlook.claim: The overall acrylic fibre market is projected to grow at a 3.9% CAGR between 2023 and 2033.
demand_outlook.quote: With the rapid growth of the apparel & textile industry and increasing usage of acrylic fibres for making apparel, the overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at 3.9% CAGR between 2023 and 2033.

demand_outlook.claim: The global market for CPP packaging films is expected to reach US$ 8,742.2 Mn by 2033, growing at a 4.2% CAGR from 2023 to 2033.
demand_outlook.quote: The global market for CPP packaging films is expected to reach US$ 8,742.2 Mn by 2033, growing at a 4.2% CAGR from 2023 to 2033.

demand_outlook.claim: India is expected to account for a substantial share of the global acrylic fibre market due to the rapid expansion of the textiles industry.
demand_outlook.quote: According to Future Market Insights (FMI), India is expected to account for a substantial share of the global acrylic fibre market, owing to the rapid expansion of the textiles industry and the rise in the export of yarns and fibres.

demand_outlook.claim: Global Acrylic Fibre consumption improved as COVID-19 related concerns subsided during the year.
demand_outlook.quote: During the year under review, Acrylic Fibre consumption has been improved as COVID-19 related concerns were subsided.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for Acrylic Fibre increased, with company sales rising to 35,260 MT compared to 30,918 MT in the previous year.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand of Acrylic Fibre has risen and the Company’s production and sales of Acrylic Fibre was 36,425 MT and 35,260 MT respectively as compared to production of 29,652 MT and sales of 30,918 MT during the previous year.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian packaging industry is experiencing robust growth driven by increased packaging requirements across sectors and rapid growth in retail and e-commerce.
demand_outlook.quote: With the rising requirement for packaging across sectors, with traditional businesses preferring to package products, and the retail and e-commerce growing rapidly, the industry is growing at a robust pace.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and began commercial production in March 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and commenced commercial production in March, 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: The company spent approximately Rs. 188 Crore on the ethanol project, funded via Rs. 104 Crore term loan and internal accruals.
capex_expansion.quote: Company has spent around Rs. 188 Crore so far which includes Rs. 104 Crore of Term Loan and Balance amount out of internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: A 750 KW solar power system was installed to assist in energy conservation.
capex_expansion.quote: Solar Power System of 750 KW has been installed.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost for the 150 KLPD ethanol project is Rs. 167.58 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The total Project cost is Rs. 167.58 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has spent around Rs. 92.17 Crore so far towards the ethanol project.
capex_expansion.quote: However, the Company has already spent around Rs. 92.17 Crore so far which includes Rs. 44.08 Crores of Term Loan and balance amount out of internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: Indian Bank sanctioned a term loan of Rs. 108 Crores for the ethanol project.
capex_expansion.quote: Indian Bank had sanctioned Term Loan of Rs. 108 Crores and as per stipulations of sanction letter, the remaining project cost of Rs. 59.58 would be met out of the Company’s internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved setting up a 150 KLPD capacity Ethanol Project at a total project cost of Rs. 167.58 crores to align with the government's Ethanol Blending Programme.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, the Company is looking forward to diversify its business in Ethanol Product and accordingly, the Board of Directors, at its meeting held on May 18, 2022, accorded its approval to the Company to set-up Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD to align with GOI’s Ethanol Blending Programme (E20), subject to clearance and approvals from the concerned statutory authorities. The total Project cost is Rs. 167.58 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has initiated steps to set up the Ethanol Plant adjoining its existing manufacturing unit in Thakurdwara, Uttar Pradesh.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has initiated steps to set up Ethanol Plant adjoining to its existing manufacturing unit – Thakurdwara, Dist. Moradabad (Uttar Pradesh).

margins_costs.claim: EBIDTA for FY 2024-25 grew by 109.31% year-on-year to Rs. 5,620.09 Lakh.
margins_costs.quote: EBIDTA was Rs. 5,620.09 Lakh as against Rs. 2,684.93 Lakh in the previous financial year, representing an increase of 109.31% over the corresponding period of last financial year.

margins_costs.claim: Losses in the CPP segment decreased due to improved realizations and overhead reduction.
margins_costs.quote: During the year under review, loss of CPP has been declined due to better realization and reduction in overheads.

margins_costs.claim: Steam consumption was reduced through the optimization of Fibre Line Drum Dryer parameters.
margins_costs.quote: Optimization parameters of Fibre Line Drum Dryer have been done which has resulted in reduction of steam consumption.

margins_costs.claim: Loss in the CPP segment was incurred due to a persistent fall in selling prices from excessive market capacity.
margins_costs.quote: Loss of CPP segment is incurred during the year caused by persistent fall in selling prices on account of excessive production capacity added in the market.

margins_costs.claim: Replacement of impulse type 8 MW turbine with reaction turbine achieved an estimated steam saving of approx. 1.00 ton/hour.
margins_costs.quote: Saving of approx. 1.00 Ton/hour steam i.e. saving per year = Rs. 100.00 Lakh

margins_costs.claim: Net profit declined during the year due to negative returns in the CPP Segment caused by a persistent drop in selling prices from market overcapacity.
margins_costs.quote: Net profit during the year declined due to negative return on CPP Segment caused by persistent fall in selling prices on account of excessive production capacity added in the market.

margins_costs.claim: The CPP segment recorded a loss before tax, exceptional items, and interest of Rs. 7.06 Crores compared to a profit of Rs. 8.52 Crores in the prior year.
margins_costs.quote: Profit/ (Loss) before tax, exceptional items and interest was Rs. (7.06) Cores as compared to Rs. 8.52 Crore in the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed production capacity for Acrylic products stands at 42,000 MT per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: The production capacity to produce Acrylic products of the Company is 42,000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: The manufacturing capacity for CPP film is 10,000 MT per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company’s production capacity to produce CPP film is 10000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: In FY 2024-25, the company produced 35,198 MT and sold 33,850 MT of Acrylic Fibre.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 35,198 MT and Sale of 33,850 MT, as against production of 31,534 MT and Sale of 31,685 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: In FY 2024-25, CPP film production and sales were 6,343 MT and 6,409 MT respectively.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of CPP film was 6,343 MT and 6,409 MT respectively as against production of 6,463 MT and sale of 6,476 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year under review, the company recorded acrylic fibre production of 31,534 MT and sales of 31,685 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 31,534 MT and Sale of 31,685 MT, as against production of 36,425 MT and Sale of 35,260 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year, production and sale of CPP film was 6,463 MT and 6,476 MT respectively.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of CPP film was 6,463 MT and 6,476 MT respectively as against production of 7,663 MT and sale of 7,640 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's production capacity for Acrylic products is 45,000 MT PA.
orders_capacity.quote: The production capacity to produce Acrylic products of the Company is 45,000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: Acrylic product production reached 36,425 MT and sales reached 35,260 MT during the fiscal year.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 36,425 MT and Sale of 35,260 MT, as against production of 29,652 MT and Sale of 30,918 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed production capacity for CPP film is 10,000 MT PA.
orders_capacity.quote: The production capacity to produce CPP film is 10000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: Production and sales of CPP film increased to 7,663 MT and 7,640 MT respectively in FY 2022-23.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of CPP film increased to 7,663 MT and 7,640 MT respectively as against production of 6,348 MT and sale of 6,210 MT respectively during the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for FY 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review the Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: No amount was transferred to the General Reserve for the financial year ended March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of your company, has decided not to transfer any amount to the General Reserve for the year ended 31st March, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2023-24 as internal accruals are utilized to set up the ethanol plant.
capital_allocation.quote: As the Company’s internal accruals is being utilized to set-up Ethanol Plant, the Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: During the year under review, the company has neither accepted nor renewed any deposits within the meaning of Section 73 of the Companies Act, 2013.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, your Company has neither accepted nor renewed any deposits within the meaning of Section 73 of the Companies Act, 2013 and the Companies (Acceptance of Deposits) Rules, 2014.

capital_allocation.claim: Management decided not to recommend a dividend for the year in order to plough back earnings and strengthen financial position.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors decided to plough back the earnings to strengthen the financials of the Company and not to recommend dividend for the year under review.

risks_headwinds.claim: Crude oil price volatility driven by geopolitical conflicts impacts raw material costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The fluctuation in crude affects the raw material prices to some extent and during the year under the review, the crude prices remained volatile due to conflict in Israel-Hamas War & Russia-Ukraine War.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fluctuations in USD vs. INR exchange rates affect profit margins due to import dependency.
risks_headwinds.quote: Additionally, since the Company is dependent upon imports, the fluctuation in foreign exchange i.e. USD vs. INR has also a bearing on the margin of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company has no control over ethanol prices, which are set by Oil Marketing Companies.
risks_headwinds.quote: The prices of ethanol products are determined by Oil Marketing Companies (“OMC”) and the Company has no control on the prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: Revenue and net profit declined due to lower demand for acrylic fibre and negative returns on the CPP segment.
risks_headwinds.quote: Revenue and Net profit during the year declined due to lower demand of acrylic fibre and negative return on CPP Segment caused by persistent fall in selling prices on account of excessive production capacity added in the market.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced challenges including crude and raw material price volatility, dumping from China, Thailand and Belarus, and foreign exchange fluctuations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite various challenges such as volatility in crude prices and raw material prices, dumping of acrylic fibre by China, Thailand and Belarus, foreign exchange fluctuations, the Company is focused on improvement in its revenue and net profit.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced headwinds including raw material and crude price volatility, foreign exchange fluctuations, and dumping of acrylic fibre by Turkey, China, Thailand, and Belarus.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite various challenges such as volatility in crude prices and abnormal rise in raw material prices, dumping of acrylic fibre by Turkey, China, Thailand and Belarus, foreign exchange fluctuations, the Company is focused on improvement in its growth and in a position to achieve a better turnover as compared to previous year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Margins are impacted by fluctuations in the USD and crude oil price rises stemming from the Russia-Ukraine war due to reliance on imported raw materials.
risks_headwinds.quote: Further, since the Company is dependent upon imported raw materials, sudden movement in USD and increase in crude oil prices due to Russia-Ukraine war affects the margin.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to commence commercial production of ethanol by September, 2024.
management_commitments.quote: Further, the Company has already initiated steps to establish grain based Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD and it is expected to commence commercial production of Ethanol by September, 2024.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
